title: Pivot grades by semester
statementMd:
For each department show the average score in `2023-fall` and `2024-spring` as two columns rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `department`, `fall`, `spring`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.department, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN e.semester = '2023-fall' THEN e.score END), 1) AS fall, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN e.semester = '2024-spring' THEN e.score END), 1) AS spring FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.department;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
